**Finding: compliant** — no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant exists in the agreement.

- Text searches for "solicit", "hire", "recruit", "induce" and "employ" surfaced no hiring restriction.
- Full reads of the plausible locations (§ 10 Confidentiality, § 13 Shared Resources, § 14 Miscellaneous, Exhibit D Personnel) confirm absence; the only personnel-adjacent terms are the § 13.5 employee NDA/invention-assignment warranty (binding Commerce One) and the § 14.5 independent contractors clause.
- This is the playbook's **preferred** outcome (no non-solicit on the Customer), so no redline was proposed.
